# Family-gold premise test (SWE-smith) — Nov 19, 2026

*Generated by scripts/premise_family_gold.py. First 1,000 rows of `SWE-bench/SWE-smith-trajectories` (tool split, streaming). Seed 0. Measurements only; no design decisions.*

Premise under test: gold = same mutation family across different repos, doppelganger = same repo across different families. Repo and family parsed from `instance_id` (`<repo>.<commit>.<family>__<suffix>`, anchored on the 8-hex commit segment, since repo names can contain dots: `pdfminer__pdfminer.six`). All 1,000 ids parsed; 991 carry a mutation family. The other 9 are a second instance class, `<repo>.<commit>.pr_<number>` (PR-mirror tasks, e.g. `encode__starlette.db5063c2.pr_2711`, `getmoto__moto.694ce1f4.pr_6509`, `dask__dask.5f61e423.pr_8501`): no mutation operator, each unique, so they cannot form same-family pairs. They stay in the SignatureStore (IDF background over all 1,000 runs) and are excluded from the pair pools.

## 5. Separations

P(x > y) over all sampled cross-pairs; ties count half. 0.5 = no separation.

| comparison | P | mean gap |
|---|---|---|
| **lexical: B > A** (trap works if > 0.5) | 0.843 | mean(A) − mean(B) = -0.178 |
| **structural: A > B** (signal exists if > 0.5) | 0.440 | mean(A) − mean(B) = -0.042 |
| lexical: A > C | 0.531 | +0.006 |
| lexical: B > C | 0.856 | +0.184 |
| structural: A > C | 0.489 | -0.007 |
| structural: B > C | 0.546 | +0.035 |

## Verdict

**Lexical trap (same-repo pairs out-word same-family pairs): holds.** P(lexical: B > A) = 0.843; mean Jaccard A = 0.254, B = 0.431 (gap -0.178). **Structural signal (scorer rates same-family-cross-repo above same-repo-cross-family): does not hold.** P(structural: A > B) = 0.440; mean motif score A = 0.461, B = 0.504 (gap -0.042). Against baseline C: lexical A−C +0.006, B−C +0.184; structural A−C -0.007, B−C +0.035.
